versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the CICD pipeline automation skill for Frontline platform users.
- Provides a step-by-step process to create a continuous update pipeline for already-deployed workloads (Deployment/StatefulSet/DaemonSet).
- Ensures strong user confirmation at every step: tenant selection, project selection, code source, language/tool/command confirmation, image registry selection, image repository and build parameters, deployment target selection, and deployment details.
- Strictly enforces platform login/token reuse rules and prevents use of incomplete or guessed information.
- Includes detailed instructions and an unmodifiable Jenkinsfile skeleton; guides users through all placeholders required for the automated pipeline.
- Not intended for first-time workload creation or infrastructure initialization scenarios.
